name: io.github.tonyyang0504/uk_companies_house-mcp
description: Companies House (sales): me, search, get_company. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UK_COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Companies House Public Data API key (free, from https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/). Sent as the HTTP Basic user name with an empty password: 'the Companies House API takes the username as the API key and ignores the password' (https://developer-specs.company-information.service.gov.uk/guides/authorisation).
